data.title: 初音未来 · 演唱会舞台
data.description: 【初音未来 · 演唱会舞台】数万人狂热欢呼的巨蛋体育馆中央，苍绿色的荧光棒汇聚成汹涌澎湃的翡翠光海。初音未来手握麦克风高高跃起，标志性的葱绿色超长双马尾在舞台射灯下耀眼夺目，向全场绽放出穿透灵魂的电子天籁——「大家的热情我都收到啦！准备好了吗？让我们一起把歌声传递到世界的每一个角落！」
data.action: 手持麦克风跃起歌唱，双脚离台，另一手向观众展开
data.camera: full-body dynamic shot, stage jump and handheld microphone visible
data.promptProse: Miku jumps above the concert stage with the microphone near her singing mouth and her free arm opening toward the audience. Sparkling stage dress and flowing sleeves follow the motion beneath arcing teal twintails. The dynamic full-body view includes both airborne feet and the stage surface, green glowsticks distant beyond. Stadium spotlights illuminate her face and outfit, while holographic projection light marks the stage beneath her suspended shadow.
